scripts.setup: npm run setup:env && npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend
scripts.backend:ensure: (test -x backend/.venv/bin/uvicorn && backend/.venv/bin/python -c "import sys; raise SystemExit(sys.version_info < (3, 10))") || (PYTHON_BIN=$(command -v python3.12 || command -v python3) && "$PYTHON_BIN" -c "import sys; raise SystemExit(sys.version_info < (3, 10))" || (echo 'Python 3.10+ is required. Install Python 3.12 and try again.' && exit 1); rm -rf backend/.venv && "$PYTHON_BIN" -m venv backend/.venv && backend/.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && backend/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt)
scripts.backend:dev: npm run backend:ensure && cd backend && .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --reload
scripts.backend:publisher: npm run backend:ensure && cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m app.publisher
scripts.migrate: npm run backend:ensure && cd backend && .venv/bin/alembic upgrade head
scripts.backend:test: npm run backend:ensure && cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m pytest
scripts.validate: npm run backend:test && npm run frontend:lint && npm run frontend:build
